Living in the UAE is a dream for many, and it becomes truly meaningful when your loved ones are by your side. Are you dreaming of living in the UAE with your family? Then this blog is specially crafted for you! Reuniting with your spouse, children, or parents has never been easier, thanks to the UAE’s streamlined family visa process. In this guide, we’ll simplify everything for you—especially the family visa cost in Dubai—to help you plan better and stay informed.

This updated guide explains the process, fees, and requirements for securing a Dubai family visa in 2025. Whether you’re a first-time sponsor or planning a visa renewal, we’ll help you begin your journey of acquiring a family visa quickly and stress-free. All the essential information—eligibility, documents, and expenses—is covered here for your convenience.

Who Can Sponsor a Family in the UAE?

You must hold a valid UAE residence visa to sponsor a family. It is essential to meet certain financial and legal criteria. You must be earning AED 4,000 per month. The income of AED 3,000 is acceptable with employer-provided accommodation.

You must be an employed resident in the UAE. It can include both men and women, under certain conditions. Freelancers and investors can also sponsor their families with valid residency.

As a sponsor, you can sponsor your spouse, children, and parents. However, the age of sons must be up to 25, while unmarried daughters with no age limit.

UAE Family Visa Rules You Need to Know in 2025

Several rules under the family visa are mandatory to follow. Fathers can sponsor their wives and children. Provided that their income and housing requirements are met. Similarly, mothers may sponsor children. This can be possible if they are the primary guardian and meet salary requirements.

Parents can be sponsored if the sponsor proves they are the sole caretaker. Note that no job restriction applies for sponsors anymore. However, special needs children have no age restrictions.

Step-by-Step: How to Apply for a Family Visa in Dubai?

You can apply online or at authorized service centers. Here’s how:

  • Obtain Entry Permit.
  • Prepare Required Documents.
  • Submit the Application.
  • Undergo Medical Test (for dependents 18+).
  • Visa Stamping and Emirates ID.

After understanding the steps to obtain a family visa, let’s move on to the document requirements and visa cost for spouses and children in Dubai.

Family Visa Documents Checklist (2025)

The document requirement is important to know, just as knowing the UAE family visa fees 2025 and eligibility criteria. The following documents must be in place when sponsoring your family under the UAE family visa:

  • Sponsor’s valid passport & residence visa copy.
  • Emirates ID of the sponsor.
  • Marriage certificate (attested).
  • Birth certificates for children (attested).
  • Medical fitness test (for dependents over 18).
  • Recent passport photos of dependents.
  • Salary certificate or MOHRE employment contract.
  • Valid tenancy contract (Ejari).

Where to Apply for a Family Visa in UAE?

For Dubai residents, the GDRFA Dubai Portal or Dubai Now App is used to apply for a UAE family visa. The other Emirates residents can visit the ICA or TAMM portals for a UAE family visa application.

Visa Validity and Renewal Process

Your initial family visa is valid for 1, 2, or 3 years. It depends on your job contract. You need to renew your visa in case of expiry. Do it at least 30 days before expiry to avoid fines. The visa renewal can be done through two methods. Visit the ICP Smart Services portal, used for all Emirates. The GDRFA portal is for Dubai residents.

If you mistakenly overstay, you’ll face fines. AED 125 for the first day will be incurred. On the other hand, AED 25 for each subsequent day

Top Tips for a Smooth Family Visa Process

Want to make your family visa process hassle-free? Must know some of the top tricks to skyrocket your visa process with no delay:

  • Double-check all documents. This helps you to achieve accuracy.
  • Ensure certificates are legally attested. It is mandatory to get easy approval.
  • Keep copies of all paperwork. Helping you to avoid any delay.
  • Track application status online. Keep yourself updated till the end.
  • Use authorized typing centers if unsure or confused about anything.

Final Thoughts: Bring Your Family Closer in the UAE

Securing a UAE family visa is easier and faster in 2025. It comes with more flexibility than ever before. Bringing your loved ones closer is the dream of so many. The UAE government has made certain amendments that make it easier for everyone to reunite with their family. The updated rules and simplified steps related to the family visa direct you to build your life together in the UAE.

FAQs About UAE Family Visas

Can I sponsor my parents?

Yes, for one year if you meet financial and legal conditions.

Can I apply without a tenancy contract?
In most cases, no. Housing proof is mandatory.

Can I renew my family’s visa online?
Yes, through the ICP or GDRFA platforms.

Can mothers sponsor children?
Yes, under specific legal and financial conditions.
